thread.title: Wall Street Recoups Losses in Wobbly Session as Tech, Financials Advance

title: Wall Street Recoups Losses in Wobbly Session as Tech, Financials Advance
text:
Wall Street Recoups Losses in Wobbly Session as Tech, Financials Advance July 02, 2018, 03:56:32 PM EDT By MT Newswires, MT Newswires Shutterstock photo
Wall Street was mixed on Monday, paring losses into the close as gains in tech and financial stocks helped the measures slip into the green, even as the benchmarks were constrained by losses in energy and consumer names.
The choppy session came amid continued worries about the impact of the trade dispute that deepened this week on the start of retaliatory tariffs on a number of US exports and talk from President Donald Trump about the World Trade Organization. Walmart ( WMT ) and Nike ( NKE ) led losses among the blue chips on the Dow Jones Industrial Average, while Goldman Sachs ( GS ) and Apple ( AAPL ) were among the gainers.
